First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: party pace. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @bffbikes the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the BFF Bikes Thursday WTF Social Ride group ride

A short party-pace ride for women, trans and femme riders from the Bucktown shop. 8 to 10 miles, very beginner friendly. The shop also runs a Sunday beginner/intermediate no-drop cruise and a faster Sunday endurance ride of 30–50 miles.
